sn35.161:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakambavane || || 2
sn35.161:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū amantesi || la || || 3
sn35.161:1.6: Cakkhu aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Rūpā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhusamphasso aniccoti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā vedayitam || pe || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || 5-8 Sotam || || Ghānam || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || 9
sn35.161:1.7: Mano anicco ti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Dhammā ||
sn35.161:1.10: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitam sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Aniccanti yathabhūtam okkhāyati || || 10
